reason: All five requested seeded native runs passed motion, the full 5–7 s hold, and settled return. Both additional allowed-factor endpoint runs passed loaded hold and settled return but violated the strict full hold-phase 5-degree tolerance: factor 0.98 reached 5.501707 degrees at thumb_ip, t=5.000 s; factor 1.02 reached 5.144587 degrees at ring_dip, t=6.720833 s after load release. Both permitted repairs are used. No full acceptance is claimed.
limitations: Saved source CAD geometry is preserved; this does not certify real hardware accuracy.
This is joint-level articulation only; motor, tendon, lead-screw transmission and dexterous grasping are not modeled.
Mass and inertia use exact cached CAD volume properties at an assumed uniform density of 1200 kg/m3.
The -2 to 65 degree joint limits and passive linear/angular damping of 4 per second are modeling assumptions.
Collisions use invisible interior capsules and a palm box, while all 69 source meshes remain intact and visible.
Native contact reporting was unavailable without an additional report schema; penetration was independently measured from collision-core geometry at every recorded native solver frame.
The public factor RNG is unspecified. Nominal seeded tests use NumPy default_rng; both 0.98 and 1.02 endpoints were additionally tested.
